title: 人不在場，容易被怪責
titleEn: He Who Is Absent Is Always in the Wrong
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for He Who Is Absent Is Always in the Wrong.
imageAltZh: 「人不在場，容易被怪責」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: People who are not present may be blamed because they cannot explain or defend their side.
meaning.zh: 某人不在場、不能說明自己的立場時，其他人容易把錯推到他身上。

formulas.formula: he who is absent is always in the wrong
formulas.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

examples.en: Jay missed the meeting, and the group blamed him for the delay without checking the record—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
examples.zh: 開會時阿傑不在，大家便把延誤歸咎於他，卻沒有人核對紀錄。
examples.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “he who is absent is always in the wrong” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「he who is absent is always in the wrong」的英文句子。

questions.prompt: While Ka was on leave, the team blamed her for a late report without checking the record.
questions.promptZh: 會議時嘉嘉請假，組員未查紀錄便把遲交報告歸咎於她。
questions.answer: The team blamed Ka before hearing her account—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 會議時嘉嘉請假，組員未查紀錄便把遲交報告歸咎於她。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: A gym key went missing, and the only employee absent from the meeting was immediately suspected.
questions.promptZh: 健身室鑰匙失蹤，唯一不在場的職員立即被懷疑。
questions.answer: The absent employee was suspected before being heard—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 健身室鑰匙失蹤，唯一不在場的職員立即被懷疑。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: After the team lost, the captain missed the review meeting and others said it was all his fault.
questions.promptZh: 校隊敗了，隊長不在檢討會上，眾人便說全是他的錯。
questions.answer: The team assigned blame to the absent captain without his response—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 校隊敗了，隊長不在檢討會上，眾人便說全是他的錯。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: An audio file was damaged; the absent technician was blamed before anyone inspected it.
questions.promptZh: 錄音檔損壞後，不在場的技術員被怪責，雖然檔案尚未檢查。
questions.answer: The technician was blamed before the file was inspected or he could reply—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 錄音檔損壞後，不在場的技術員被怪責，雖然檔案尚未檢查。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: When supplies ran out, staff blamed the buyer who was on holiday without checking the orders.
questions.promptZh: 餐廳缺貨時，休假的採購員被指責，其他人卻未查看訂單。
questions.answer: Staff blamed the buyer before checking the orders or hearing from her—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 餐廳缺貨時，休假的採購員被指責，其他人卻未查看訂單。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: After a display fell, the absent designer was blamed; nobody asked who moved it.
questions.promptZh: 展板跌倒後，缺席的設計師被怪責；沒人問當時是誰把展板移位。
questions.answer: The absent designer was blamed before anyone checked who moved the display—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 展板跌倒後，缺席的設計師被怪責；沒人問當時是誰把展板移位。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: A wrong notice was sent; an offline moderator was blamed before the other moderators checked the log.
questions.promptZh: 群組誤發通知，沒有上線的管理員被責怪，其他管理員尚未查記錄。
questions.answer: The offline moderator took the blame before anyone checked the log—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 群組誤發通知，沒有上線的管理員被責怪，其他管理員尚未查記錄。

questions.prompt: Bin missed a family discussion, and relatives said he caused all the moving trouble.
questions.promptZh: 阿彬缺席家庭討論，親戚便說搬家的麻煩都是他造成。
questions.answer: Relatives blamed Bin while he was not there to tell his side—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 阿彬缺席家庭討論，親戚便說搬家的麻煩都是他造成。
questions.highlight: he who is absent is always in the wrong

questions.prompt: A box of books was missing; a volunteer absent from stocktake was blamed before loan records were checked.
questions.promptZh: 圖書館遺失一箱書，缺席點算的義工先被責怪，借還記錄仍未查。
questions.answer: The volunteer was blamed without being heard or checking the loans—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 圖書館遺失一箱書，缺席點算的義工先被責怪，借還記錄仍未查。

questions.prompt: Trip photos vanished, and a friend who missed the discussion was accused of deleting them.
questions.promptZh: 旅行照片不見了，沒有參加討論的朋友被指刪除檔案。
questions.answer: The friend was accused while unable to answer the group—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 旅行照片不見了，沒有參加討論的朋友被指刪除檔案。

questions.prompt: A decision drew complaints, and the former chair absent from a new meeting was treated as solely responsible.
questions.promptZh: 一項決定引起投訴，沒有出席新會議的舊主席被當作唯一責任人。
questions.answer: The absent former chair was blamed before the group examined who made the decision—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
questions.answerZh: 一項決定引起投訴，沒有出席新會議的舊主席被當作唯一責任人。

questions.prompt: A rehearsal time changed; the ill choreographer was blamed without anyone calling to check with her.
questions.promptZh: 排演時間被改，正在生病的編舞者被怪責，但沒有人打電話向她核實。
questions.answer: The choreographer was blamed while unable to offer her account—he who is absent is always in the wrong.
